summary: This batch reports five building collapses and four extensively damaged structures across Chinatown, Nob Hill, and the Financial District, with 15 people reported trapped in total (highest-confidence collapses at 27 Dashiell Hammett St and 705 Sansome St). Road debris is blocking St George Alley, Pine St, and an alley off 845 California St, while buildings at 28 Prescott Court, 181 Fremont St, and 246 Kearny St checked in safe with little to no damage.
